translations.Changes apply to new attempts. Existing: Changes apply to new attempts. Existing pauses keep their expiry time. The check uses saved settings; save changes first.
translations.Explicitly link a Vereinsflieger ID to a: Explicitly link a Vereinsflieger ID to an existing Nextcloud account.
translations.Use the internal account ID. The Vereins: Use the internal account ID. The Vereinsflieger ID is the API uid, not the membership number. Files, account ID and admin rights are preserved. Verified first and last names are updated after a completed VF login.
translations.Link existing accounts by matching email: Link existing accounts by matching email on first Vereinsflieger login
translations.Disabled by default. Requires one active: Disabled by default. Requires one active account with a unique matching email. Administrators and local-only accounts are excluded. The stable VF ID is saved; later email changes do not switch accounts.
translations.Members can change their Vereinsflieger: Members can change their Vereinsflieger email. While enabled, a matching VF email grants access to the existing account’s files. Enable temporarily for a controlled migration, then disable.
translations.Linked SSO accounts cannot log in with a: Linked SSO accounts cannot log in with a local account password, even after a password reset. Existing sessions, remember cookies and Nextcloud app passwords follow Nextcloud’s rules. Explicitly excluded accounts remain local.
translations.Create new members on their first succes: Create new members on their first successful Vereinsflieger login
translations.Requires first name, last name and a val: Requires first name, last name and a valid email. Club ID and stable VF uid are saved. Existing email addresses require a manual link or explicitly enabled email migration.
translations.Local login only – exclude from Vereinsf: Local login only – exclude from Vereinsflieger
Select multiple accounts with Ctrl or ⌘. Include emergency administrators. Exclusion takes precedence over account links. Changes affect future logins; running sessions are not revoked.
translations.No accounts created or linked automatica: No accounts created or linked automatically yet.
translations.Only explicitly mapped roles change grou: Only explicitly mapped roles change group memberships.
translations.Missing target groups: %s. Fix or remove: Missing target groups: %s. Fix or remove these mappings. Login remains possible; all memberships are preserved when an affected sync is skipped.
translations.Last skipped group sync: %s · %s · missi: Last skipped group sync: %s · %s · missing groups: %s. Synchronization is retried at the next VF login after correction.
translations.No roles received yet. Log in with a lin: No roles received yet. Log in with a linked account while group synchronization is disabled. Received roles then become available.
translations.The admin group is excluded. Existing lo: The admin group is excluded. Existing local memberships are preserved; only memberships added by this app can be removed. Changes apply at the next VF login.
translations.Roles are saved per club after successfu: Roles are saved per club after successful login. Mappings use only these exact names. A saved role grants no membership unless it is returned again at that user’s login.
translations.No roles received yet. A successful Vere: No roles received yet. A successful Vereinsflieger login supplies the first snapshot.

translations.New accounts require a Vereinsflieger fi: New accounts require a Vereinsflieger first name, last name and valid email address.
